modelFamilyNotes.samplingParamsRejected: Reject temperature/topP in favour of reasoning-effort controls: Claude Sonnet 5, Opus 4.7+ (including Opus 5) and the Fable/Mythos 5 tier, notably as served through Vertex. Patterns, because gateway ids carry arbitrary prefixes and suffixes (vertex_ai/claude-sonnet-5@20260203).
modelFamilyNotes.forcedToolChoiceRejected: Answer a forced tool_choice (any or tool) with a 400: "tool_choice: type \"tool\" and \"any\" are not supported for this model." Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 were probed live on Vertex; the Fable 5.1 docs state the same, and Mythos 5.1 shares Fable 5.1's capabilities. The same families also refuse thinking: {type: "disabled"}.
modelFamilyNotes.betweenToolsThinking: Of forcedToolChoiceRejected, the ones that accept thinking: {type: "between_tools"} as their lowest setting. The rest think adaptively, always on, and take no thinking field in its place.
modelFamilyNotes.claudeModernVision: Name-first Claude ids with major version 4 or later (claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-4-7, claude-haiku-4-5) plus Fable/Mythos. Legacy number-first 3.x ids (claude-3-5-haiku) deliberately do not match: claude-3-5-haiku, the last non-vision Claude, must stay rejected.
modelFamilyNotes.gemini25: Gemini 2.5: rejects thinkingLevel with 400 "thinking_level not supported"; takes thinkingBudget.
modelFamilyNotes.maxCompletionTokens: Reasoning-class OpenAI models (o-series, gpt-5+) reject max_tokens and take max_completion_tokens. Matched against the id after its last '/'.
modelFamilyNotes.restrictedOutput: Output capped at gemini.json reasoning.restrictedOutputTokenLimit, as are the imageGeneration models (matched as prefixes).

modelListNotes.imageGeneration: Image-generation models, not text. isImageGenerationModel matches an entry exactly or bounded by - _ : . / @ or the ends, so short ids such as V_1 (Ideogram) don't match unrelated names. Groups: Gemini image (Vertex, AI Studio); Stability; Ideogram model versions; Recraft; OpenAI DALL-E and GPT-Image; Replicate slugs (matched as a slug prefix).
modelListNotes.pdfImageGeneration: Models that can generate images from PDFs.
modelListNotes.vertexGlobalLocationText: Gemini 3.x text models that Vertex serves only on the global endpoint (aiplatform.googleapis.com). GLOBAL_LOCATION_MODELS is imageGeneration followed by this list, so a new image model is routed to global too.
